author: Ryan McCaffrey
description: EVE Frontier remains a dream with two parallel stories running through it, unavoidably. There's the gloomy, spectacular, horror-laden PvE world of fallen temples and Feral drones, of keeping your clone alive in the unforgiving environments of space. And there's the desire to hand control over to the players, for better or worse, using blockchain technology and cryptocurrency, which have both become so closely associated in my mind at this point with scams and techbro nonsense that I can't fully place my trust in this MMO just yet. It's going to remain a wait-and-see for a long time yet, I suspect.
title: EVE Frontier is Leaning into Space Survival Horror | IGN Preview
